security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are Markdown fence false positives around TSX examples and role names. Two command blocks are real risks because they instruct users to run npx installers that fetch remote content, and one remote image plus one installer URL create low network exposure. No prompt injection or hidden data-exfiltration instructions were found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin tool versions and document expected files before users run shadcn or skills installers.
Use a repository-local image or clearly disclose that rendering documentation contacts cloud.inference.sh.
Move related skill install commands behind optional manual steps and warn users to audit each added skill.

content.value_statement: Chat interfaces require repeated layout, message, and input work. This skill provides React and Next.js patterns for containers, messages, inputs, typing states, and styling.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to install chat components with the shadcn CLI and a remote registry URL.
Demonstrates ChatContainer, ChatMessage, ChatInput, and TypingIndicator usage.
Provides a full React chat example with message state and loading state.
Documents user, assistant, and system message variants.
Shows Tailwind and shadcn/ui token styling through className examples.
limitations: It does not implement backend APIs, model calls, or message persistence.
It does not include authentication, authorization, or moderation controls.
Streaming behavior is only represented through UI states and documentation links.
The quick start depends on external npx and registry resources.

output_examples.input: Review the integration steps before installation.

best_practices: Pin remote installer versions and review added files before merging.
Keep API calls and secret handling outside client-side UI components.
Test keyboard behavior, loading states, and responsive layouts.
anti_patterns: Run npx installer commands without reviewing downloaded files.
Place API keys or server tokens in client-side chat components.
Treat the UI examples as a complete backend or moderation system.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for React and Next.js chat UI components, including containers, messages, input, and typing indicators.

faq.question: Does it include a backend?
faq.answer: No. You must provide your own API calls, storage, authentication, and model integration.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it support streaming responses?
faq.answer: It shows UI states for loading and typing. You still need to connect your own streaming transport.

faq.question: What framework does it expect?
faq.answer: The examples target React or Next.js with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui design tokens.

faq.question: What should I review before use?
faq.answer: Review remote installer commands, downloaded files, and any changes before adding the components to a project.
